name: BSP_Entity_IsBelowAltitudeThird
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ai_attackmove_substates, read-only analysis. __thiscall(entity) -> bool, RET 0, body 00852860-008528AC, read complete. Refreshes the pose when entity+0C8h is zero (0085286C), then returns entity+100h (world y) <= ([entity+1204h] + [entity+1200h]) / 3.0. The MOV EAX,1 / TEST AL,AL / SETZ CL tail at 00852892 is a logical NOT written out, so the JBE side is the TRUE side. Seven callers: the attackmove selector at 009E873B, where it gates a kind-8 target onto the two attack sub-states, plus six HUD marker routines, so the contract is not AI-specific. The producer of +1200h/+1204h is unknown. docs/SHIP_AI_ATTACKMOVE_SUBSTATES.md

name: BSP_TorpedoProjectileShot_EnterWater
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Shot interface vtable 00D0C378 slot +28h, against 006E6450 in the base. Breaks the torpedo up when the impact speed exceeds classDesc[+DCh] MaxWaterHitVel or shot[+0Ch] is below the negation of classDesc[+ECh], the fall speed 00855A90 derives as sqrt(2*MaxFall*9.81); otherwise it calls the base entry and spawns classDesc[+D8h] WaterSplashEfx. In world mode 2 it enters water instead of killing the entity. The depth charge's 006FD660 applies the identical rule with +ECh and +F0h. Partial: the effect construction is a contract. docs/TORPEDO_TICK.md.

name: BSP_TorpedoProjectile_Steer
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Called only from the swim advance at 00857531. __thiscall(record, float dt), RET 4. Gated on classDesc[+F0h] HomingHorzTurnSpeed > 0; re-scans on the record+518h countdown with interval record+514h for the nearest entity answering vtable[5Ch](8), binding it through the observer at record+4FCh with the pointer at record+510h, and writes the target bearing into record+46Ch. The two homing turns are clamped to HomingVertTurnSpeed*dt about the hull's right axis and HomingHorzTurnSpeed*dt about its up axis, and both 00438B10 calls read the same two pitch slots. On every other path it runs the depth controller against BSP_GameWorld_SampleWaterHeight with gains record+480h and record+484h, clamped to plus or minus 5, and turns toward record+46Ch at classDesc[+E8h] HeadingTurn degrees per second. Partial: the candidate list container 00856C28-00856C63 unread. docs/TORPEDO_TICK.md.
